input_wave: V1_peak/sqrt(2*50 ohm), measured complex voltage; no nominal-power substitute
output_wave: V3_peak/sqrt(2*Z3), with archived complex Z retained and V/P/Z consistency checked
analysis: Extract H5/H7/H9/H11 independently at A and B using measured input and existing common-limiter convention.
Test unchanged coefficients with changed common response at B; report residual, do not assume parameter dependence.
Freeze B coefficients, normalization, code hashes and prediction before examining C. Acquisition tool does not fit coefficients or enforce analyst blinding.
Predict independent source terms at C with frozen B coefficients. Preserve missing/low-power terms and warnings; never zero-fill, refit or widen tolerance.
A and D are controls and do not increase the independent prediction denominator. Common-response mismatch must not be forced into coefficient changes.
stop: Stop on invalid identity, warning, stale data, mismatch, failed collection or unresolved timeout. Preserve every attempt; do not resubmit or start subsequent analyses. Restore original state without another analysis after resolving any running collector.
boundary: One OP1dB dependence pilot only; no proprietary coefficient law, automatic RFAMP factory or complete SystemVue compatibility claim. No new native coefficients or vendor measurements supplied.
